lessons.title: Daily Tasks

items.exampleMeaning: Today I have a lot of work.

items.example: La reunión es a las diez.
items.exampleMeaning: The meeting is at ten.
My schedule is flexible.

items.example: Voy a enviar un correo electrónico.
items.exampleMeaning: I am going to send an email.

items.example: Estoy trabajando en un proyecto nuevo.
items.exampleMeaning: I am working on a new project.
I have an important task today.

lessons.tip: In Spanish, nouns have gender. 'El' is used for masculine nouns and 'la' for feminine nouns. For example, 'el trabajo' is masculine and 'la reunión' is feminine.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What work do you have today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hoy tengo una reunión y una tarea.
dialogue.meaning: Today I have a meeting and a task.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What time is the meeting?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: La reunión es a las diez.
dialogue.meaning: The meeting is at ten.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What is your schedule?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: My schedule is flexible.

scenario.partnerRole: A colleague who is curious about your work.
scenario.brief: You are discussing your daily work tasks with a colleague. Ask questions about their schedule and share your tasks.
scenario.goal: You will explain your tasks and your schedule.

lessons.title: Office Vocabulary

items.exampleMeaning: I work in a big office.
My desk is messy.
I need a new chair.
I use my computer to work.
My phone is ringing.
The printer is not working.

lessons.tip: Remember that nouns in Spanish have articles. Use 'la' for feminine nouns like 'la oficina' and 'el' for masculine nouns like 'el teléfono'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Where is your office?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mi oficina está en el tercer piso.
dialogue.meaning: My office is on the third floor.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you have a new computer?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, my computer is fast.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Does the printer work?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: No, the printer is not working.

scenario.partnerRole: A coworker interested in your office setup.
scenario.brief: You are talking to a coworker about your office. Discuss the location and equipment in your office.
scenario.goal: You will describe your office and its equipment.

lessons.title: Meetings and Agendas

items.example: La agenda está en mi correo electrónico.
items.exampleMeaning: The agenda is in my email.
I have a presentation tomorrow.

items.example: Soy un participante en la reunión.
items.exampleMeaning: I am a participant in the meeting.
We are going to discuss the project.
I took notes during the meeting.
Do you have any questions?

lessons.tip: Use 'la' for feminine nouns like 'la agenda' and 'las notas', and 'el' for masculine nouns like 'el participante' and 'el proyecto'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: ¿Cuál es la agenda de la reunión?
dialogue.meaning: What is the agenda for the meeting?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: La agenda está en mi correo electrónico.
dialogue.meaning: The agenda is in my email.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What are we going to discuss?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Vamos a discutir el proyecto y la presentación.
dialogue.meaning: We are going to discuss the project and the presentation.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Who are the participants?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Soy un participante en la reunión.
dialogue.meaning: I am a participant in the meeting.

scenario.partnerRole: A team member preparing for a meeting.
scenario.learnerRole: You, explaining the agenda and topics.
scenario.brief: You are preparing for a meeting with a team member. Discuss the agenda and what will be discussed.
scenario.goal: You will explain the meeting agenda and topics.

lessons.title: Daily Routines

items.exampleMeaning: I have a daily routine.

items.example: Siempre como desayuno a las ocho.
items.exampleMeaning: I always have breakfast at eight.

items.example: Voy a trabajar a las nueve.
items.exampleMeaning: I go to work at nine.

items.example: El almuerzo es a las doce.
items.exampleMeaning: Lunch is at twelve.

items.example: Salgo de la oficina a las cinco.
items.exampleMeaning: I leave the office at five.

items.example: Me gusta descansar después del trabajo.
items.exampleMeaning: I like to rest after work.

lessons.tip: Use 'el' for masculine nouns like 'el desayuno' and 'el almuerzo', and 'la' for feminine nouns like 'la rutina' and 'la oficina'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What is your daily routine?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I wake up early and have breakfast.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What time do you work?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Voy a trabajar a las nueve.
dialogue.meaning: I go to work at nine.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: ¿A qué hora sales de la oficina?
dialogue.meaning: What time do you leave the office?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Salgo de la oficina a las cinco.
dialogue.meaning: I leave the office at five.

scenario.partnerRole: A friend asking about your daily routine.
scenario.brief: You are sharing your daily routine with a friend. Talk about your morning, work, and evening activities.
scenario.goal: You will describe your daily routine.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What work do you have today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hoy tengo una reunión y una tarea.
dialogue.meaning: Today I have a meeting and a task.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Where is your office?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mi oficina está en el tercer piso.
dialogue.meaning: My office is on the third floor.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What time is lunch?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: El almuerzo es a las doce.
dialogue.meaning: Lunch is at twelve.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you have any questions about the agenda?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: No, everything is clear.

scenario.partnerRole: A friend reviewing your work life.
scenario.learnerRole: You, answering questions about your job and routine.
scenario.brief: You are having a conversation with a friend about your work life. Answer their questions about your office, tasks, and daily routine.
scenario.goal: You will review what you learned about work-related vocabulary.
